It follows the 1989-1992 manga closely and set the bar for later part adaptations.

encyclopedia.summary: A creature that blew a piece of the moon off becomes homeroom teacher of class 3-E, and the students are given one year to kill him. Lerche made the 2015 TV anime from Yusei Matsui's manga. The premise — assassination drills and career worries happening in the same classroom — is what gives the show its character.
highlights: Teacher and students can kill each other, and lessons still run as lessons — the joke holds for a whole year.
The assassination job keeps colliding with each student's plans after graduation, and the tone shifts with it.
Koro-sensei's identity is settled early; the open question becomes why this class.

The 1997 TV anime borrows the shapes of fairy tales and stage plays to work through growing up and power. Kunihiko Ikuhara directed it, with J.C.STAFF animating.
highlights: Repeated duels and songs turn every episode into a piece of theatre.
It flips the fairy-tale prince into a question about a girl standing on her own.
By the end the rules of the world itself come apart.

encyclopedia.summary: Behind a peaceful Japan, a unit of girls called Lycoris handles the assassinations and guard work that keep it that way. Two of them run a café, LycoReco, as a front and switch between errands and ordinary days. A-1 Pictures produced it, broadcast in 2022.

Chisato and Takina's relationship carries the argument about the organisation and personal freedom.
Its characters and opening theme drove a large wave of fan work while it aired.
